articles.title: Quantum computing nears commercial breakthrough, IBM CEO says
articles.snippet: Arvind Krishna said quantum computing will begin generating meaningful revenue before the decade ends as investment in the sector accelerates, in an interview on CNBC.

articles.title: Coldcard hack sparks biggest sub-1 BTC move since FTX: CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: Bitcoin users moved 39,600 BTC in small transactions as the Coldcard hack continued, with researchers warning that the attack remained active.

articles.title: Bitcoin Quantum Threat Inches Closer as IBM Claims 'Trusted Quantum Advantage'
articles.snippet: The advance reflects IBM’s continued progress toward machines powerful enough to challenge today's cryptography.

articles.title: There's a New Way to Protect Bitcoin From Future Quantum Attacks, Researchers Say
articles.snippet: New research outlines a cryptographic approach that could allow Bitcoin and other blockchain wallets to remain compatible with existing addresses in a post-quantum future.
